On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Diane Hall <diane.hall@summitpay.com> wrote:
> Quick note from SummitPay finance — we completed a bank consolidation across our payout rails and need Redwood to update our vendor record that was created during onboarding.

Hi Diane — thanks for sending these over. For Redwood Procurement/Payments to accept a bank-change we typically need the following (one or more items below):

Required for ACH changes:
- Bank confirmation letter on bank letterhead (we have this)
- Either a voided check OR ACH authorization form from the bank (we do not accept screenshots of account numbers alone)
- Updated, signed W-9 (we have the signed W-9)
- Vendor portal screenshot showing vendor ID and remittance endpoint helps speed matching

If you can upload the voided check (scan/photo) or an ACH authorization, we can proceed with validation today. Please use this secure upload folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3C-DOCS (or reply with attachments).

Timeline: once we receive the missing ACH proof we run a 24–48 hour verification (bank letter + ACH proof + W-9). After verification we will:
- update the vendor remittance endpoint in our AP system (record ID V-78921)
- reroute new POs automatically to the updated account
- for existing open POs, we’ll either issue an amendment or confirm payment routing case-by-case — please list any urgent PO numbers in your reply.

If you prefer, we can also accept a notarized ACH authorization. Attachments accepted: PDF/JPG/PNG.

Thanks — I’ll monitor the upload folder and kick off validation as soon as we have the ACH proof.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
